_note: Hand-written annotations for COMPILATION-MAP.md (task T25). Keys are Compiler.Visit* method names / helper names. Each text was written from reading Compiler.cs (FACT-SRC); see .work/notes/src_System.Management.Automation_engine_parser_Compiler.cs.md.

VisitErrorStatement: returns null; error nodes never reach the compiler because a script with parse errors cannot be turned into a script block
VisitScriptBlock: builds one Expression<Action<FunctionContext>> per named block (DynamicParam, Begin, Process, End, Clean); function name suffixes `<Begin>` etc.; param block is not compiled (defaults come from parameter metadata); the first compiled block also defines classes/usings when the script block is the root
VisitTypeConstraint: assert false; type constraints are handled by their parents
VisitAttribute: assert false; attributes are turned into attribute objects by GetAttribute at metadata time
VisitParameter: assert false; parameters become RuntimeDefinedParameter metadata (GetParameterMetaData)
VisitNamedBlock: assert false; CompileNamedBlock is called from VisitScriptBlock
VisitStatementBlock: CompileStatementListWithTraps -> Block (Empty if no statements); each statement wrapped for error-action handling
VisitTypeDefinition: Empty; types are defined by GenerateTypesAndUsings for the root block
VisitFunctionMember: returns null; member bodies are compiled as separate script blocks with member-function mode
VisitUsingStatement: Empty; usings are loaded by GenerateLoadUsings in the root prolog
VisitConfigurationDefinition: compiles the AST built by GenerateSetItemPipelineAst (set-item function:<name>); DSC, out of scope
VisitDynamicKeywordStatement: meta statements -> Empty; otherwise compiles the AST built by GenerateCommandCallPipelineAst; DSC, out of scope
VisitFunctionDefinition: FunctionOps.DefineFunction(context, ast, ScriptBlockExpressionWrapper); the function body is not compiled with the parent, only when the wrapper's script block first runs
VisitIfStatement: nested Expression.IfThenElse from last clause to first; condition = CaptureStatementResults(cond, Condition) converted to bool; position update before each condition
VisitTrap: assert false; traps are compiled by CompileTrap from statement lists
VisitAssignmentStatement: CompileAssignment: destructuring (array LHS) uses PSArrayAssignmentRHSBinder; otherwise ReduceAssignment through IAssignableValue (SetValue / dynamic binary op for +=, -=, ...)
VisitPipelineChain: && / || over pipelines: statement-index dispatch with try/catch (like statement lists), `if ($?)` / `if (-not $?)` between elements, background chains call PipelineOps.InvokePipelineInBackground; no trap handlers are pushed
VisitPipeline: single expression -> compiled expression (with redirections via GetRedirectedExpression); otherwise PipelineOps.InvokePipeline(input, ignoreInput, CommandParameterInternal[][] per command, command asts, redirections, funcContext); background -> InvokePipelineInBackground; position update unless parent is assignment/paren
VisitMergingRedirection: returns a MergingRedirection value (not an Expression)
VisitFileRedirection: Expression.New(FileRedirection(stream, append, fileName)); non-constant file names converted with PSToStringBinder
VisitCommand: NewArrayInit(CommandParameterInternal[]): first element is the command name argument, then parameters/arguments; numeric literals keep their source text (WrappedNumber); strict-mode check for `f (args)` call syntax
VisitCommandExpression: compile expression; unless pre/post increment or void, write value to funcContext._outputPipe (CallAddPipe)
VisitSwitchStatement: saves/restores `$_`; -file reads lines with StreamReader; otherwise GenerateIteratorStatement with `$switch`; per item every clause is tested (constant script block, regex, wildcard, exact string, or PSSwitchClauseEvalBinder) - all matching clauses run; default clause when none matched
VisitDataStatement: sets context.LanguageMode to RestrictedLanguage around the body, runtime checks for allowed commands, assigns result to the data variable
VisitForEachStatement: GenerateIteratorStatement with `$foreach`; enumerator via PSEnumerableBinder; body assigns the loop variable then runs the body
VisitDoWhileStatement: GenerateDoLoop: body, then test; jump back while true
VisitForStatement: initializer; GenerateWhileLoop with condition and iterator as the `continue` action
VisitCatchClause: assert false; catch bodies are compiled by VisitTryStatement
VisitTryStatement: ExpressionType.Try; catch-all-only form catches RuntimeException (PipelineStoppedException rethrown), typed catches use ExceptionHandlingOps.FindMatchingHandler + switch; `$_` set to the ErrorRecord; finally wraps SuspendStoppingPipeline/RestoreStoppingPipeline
VisitBreakStatement: GenerateBreakOrContinue: Expression.Break to the matching compiled loop label, else throw BreakException(label)
VisitReturnStatement: writes the value to the output pipe (or return pipe in class methods) then Expression.Return to the block's return label; inside a trap lambda throws ReturnException
VisitThrowStatement: ExceptionHandlingOps.ConvertToException(value, extent, isRethrow); `throw` with no value rethrows the exception being handled
VisitTernaryExpression: Expression.Condition(cond as bool, ifTrue as object, ifFalse as object)
VisitBinaryExpression: constant-folded when constant; -and/-or -> AndAlso/OrElse over bool; double,double + - * / native; other arithmetic and comparisons via DynamicExpression with PSBinaryOperationBinder; -like/-match/-replace/-split/-join/-contains/-in/-is/-as/-f/.. -> ParserOps/StringOps/TypeOps helper calls; ?? -> Coalesce
VisitUnaryExpression: constant-folded when constant; -not/! PSUnaryOperationBinder; unary +/- as 0+x / 0-x; -bnot OnesComplement; ++/-- CompileIncrementOrDecrement; unary -join/-split helper calls
VisitConvertExpression: constant-folded; [ordered]@{} -> OrderedDictionary; [pscustomobject]@{} -> converter; [ref]$x -> VariableOps.GetVariableAsRef; otherwise ConvertValue: Expression.Convert or PSConvertBinder, PSDynamicConvertBinder when the type is unresolved at compile time
VisitSubExpression: no statements -> $null; else CaptureAstResults (temporary output pipe collecting results)
VisitVariableExpression: $null/$true/$false constants; automatic variables via tuple slot or VariableOps.GetAutomaticVariableValue; TupleIndex < 0 -> VariableOps.GetVariableValue (by name); else tuple field access
VisitTypeExpression: reflection Type constant if resolvable at compile time, else TypeOps.ResolveTypeName at run time
VisitMemberExpression: static [T]::Member with a unique public static field/property -> direct access; else PSGetMemberBinder / PSGetDynamicMemberBinder; `?.` wrapped in a null check
VisitInvokeMemberExpression: InvokeMember: PSInvokeMemberBinder, PSCreateInstanceBinder for `[T]::new`, PSInvokeDynamicMemberBinder for non-constant names; argument/target type constraints passed to the binder
VisitArrayExpression: @( ) : empty -> object[0]; single pure expression -> that expression wrapped to array; else CaptureAstResults(Enumerable)
VisitHashtable: new Hashtable(count, OrdinalIgnoreCase) then HashtableOps.AddKeyValuePair per pair; each value statement captured with CaptureStatementResults
VisitScriptBlockExpression: ScriptBlockExpressionWrapper.GetScriptBlock(context, false); the block body is compiled lazily on first run
VisitParenExpression: assignment -> CompileAssignment; otherwise CaptureStatementResults of the pipeline
VisitExpandableStringExpression: StringOps.FormatOperator(format string, string[] of nested expressions converted with PSToStringBinder)
VisitIndexExpression: PSGetIndexBinder with 1 or n index arguments; `?[]` wrapped in a null check
VisitAttributedExpression: child.Accept(this); attributes only matter on assignment targets
